title: Friday
summary: A short day name carrying a story from long ago.
question: Where did Friday get its name?
completion: Friday keeps an older goddess name, Frīg, in English. German Freitag shares that naming family. The Roman calendar used Venus’s day; Friday was not named after frying food.
partner: A similar sound is a clue. Let’s check the evidence.
